notes.1.3: A legal decision on a disputed document. jr,w, rendered 'witnesses', is uncertain. Line 5: bꜣ,w=k r=f nṯr, 'your power against him, O god', seems to be the wording of an oath; the construction is unclear. Line 7: m wnm n sb[j]n=f is obscure; sbjn is unexplained. Line 8: jmj-rʾ-jꜥꜣw may also be 'overseer of foreign troops'.

nodes.text: [...] his wife, his children and all his property within it, in order to settle the children [...] of this Weser there, treating the great according to his greatness, [treating] the small [according to] his smallness.
This Tjau said: 'His father never made it anywhere.'

If this Sobekhotep brings three excellent witnesses who are strong [about] [it], they shall perform 'your power against him, O god' that this document was indeed made according to what this Weser said [there].
It shall be within his [possession], that of this Sobekhotep, once he has brought these three witnesses who state this matter alongside them.
Now this Sobekhotep is in the right concerning his *sbjn*(?).

If he does not bring three witnesses who state this matter alongside them, nothing at all of this Weser's shall remain with him, but it shall remain with his son, the noble of the king, overseer of interpreters, Tjau.
